body.zh:
怎么用这一页

这是摇滚史课程目录页。结构按 John Covach（University of Rochester）课弧：先产业与电台，再 1955–59 rock & roll，60 年代初的「摇滚之冬 / 灵乐之春」，英伦入侵，美国的回应，Motown 与南部灵魂乐，迷幻，然后进入 70 年代「摇滚怪兽」。

第一至三章各小节已可点开阅读。后面章节先列目录占位，讲义到了再补正文。出现人名时，本站有对应年代 / 乐队页就跳过去。无聊就跳——后面引用前面时再回来。
body.en:
How to use this page

This is the rock-history syllabus map, following John Covach’s University of Rochester arc: industry and radio first, then 1955–59 rock & roll, the early-60s “winter,” British Invasion, U.S. replies, Motown / southern soul, psychedelia, then the 1970s “monster” years.

Chapters 1–3 are open for reading. Later chapters stay as stubs until lecture notes land. When a name appears, jump to the matching era or band page if we have it. Skip ahead when bored—come back when a later section cites an earlier one.

附录 · 其他补充推荐阅读书籍

title.zh: 《摇滚编年史 Rock Chronicles》美 David Roberts 主编

summary.en: If you only pick one band book, start here. ~250 influential acts: short histories, lineups/changes, key albums, classic photos, A–Z for lookup. Narrow and shallow—great bands exceed 250, and the cut-off misses later acts—but still solid for tracing who did what when.
summary.zh: 如果只能选一本乐队书，首选这本。收录摇滚史以来最有影响力的 250 余支乐队，简明写历史、成员与变更、代表作，并配经典历史照片；字母序方便翻查。覆盖偏窄、内容偏浅——优秀乐队远不止 250，每支都够写几百万字——且出版较早，近年乐队未收。作资料书查发展脉络仍很好用。

title.en: 1001 Albums You Must Hear Before You Die — ed. Robert Dimery
title.zh: 《有生之年非听不可的1001张唱片》美 Robert Dimery 主编

summary.en: Chronological checklist of 1001 albums from the 1950s into the 21st century—not rock-only: jazz, pop, folk, hip-hop too. Each entry: artist, producer, year, label, key tracks, short take. Useful for hunting records and sketching how popular music moved. Newest English runs to 2018; the Chinese import (Central Compilation Press) is still the 8th edition (2005 update).
summary.zh: 唱片名录：主编精选自 50 年代到 21 世纪的 1001 张经典，按时间排。不只摇滚，也有爵士、流行、民谣、嘻哈等——按图索骥听片之外，也能大概看欧美流行乐坛走势。每条写演唱者、制作人、发行年、厂牌、经典曲与初步评价。英文最新 2018 年版国内尚未引进；中央编译出版社引进至今只有第 8 版（2005 年更新），有点遗憾。

title.zh: 《摇滚谱系 Rock Connections：摇滚乐完全历程》英 Bruno MacDonald 主编

summary.en: Less dense than the two above; stronger on how styles and bands connect—people, scenes, inheritance. Plenty of lesser-known anecdotes; more fun to read for lineage than for encyclopedia entries.
summary.zh: 比前两本更侧重风格与乐队之间的联系。内容丰富度略逊，但胜在用人与人、人与历史的关系，写出摇滚如何发展、风格如何传承影响。夹不少不为人知的小故事，读起来更有趣味。

title.en: Rock: Rock's Past and Present — Kevin J. H. Dettmar
title.zh: 《摇滚：摇滚的前世今生》美 Kevin J. H. Dettmar 著

summary.en: Another rock survey, written by a professor—deeper cultural discussion and the author’s own thinking alongside the timeline. Downside: non-color printing leaves many photos muddy.
summary.zh: 同为摇滚通史。作者是教授，探讨与文化研究更深入，也更有人文气息；记史之外写了不少自己的思考。缺点是非彩色印刷，很多照片看起来模模糊糊。

title.en: The Greatest Albums You'll Never Hear — ed. Bruno MacDonald
title.zh: 《无法发行的60张唱片》美 Bruno MacDonald 编著

summary.en: Odd angle: albums you will never hear. Less a listening guide than music gossip—why they stayed unreleased: creative collapse, feuds, label and market choices. Genuinely fun to read.
summary.zh: 角度奇特：介绍的那些唱片，你永远听不到。与其说是推荐指南，不如说是独辟蹊径的音乐八卦——为何不能发行？创作状态、爱恨情仇、厂牌与市场的选择。读来还挺有趣。

title.zh: 《吉他族谱 Guitar Family Trees》美 Terry Burrows 著

summary.en: Treasure shelf for guitar fans: famous guitars and makers, players’ instruments, tone traits, and tracks that show each model’s voice.
summary.zh: 吉他爱好者的宝藏书：著名吉他与厂商历史，名手所用琴、音色特点，以及该型号音色的代表曲目。

title.zh: 《制造音乐 How Music Works》美 David Byrne 著

summary.en: After the history arc, how music gets made—ideas, writing, stage, recording, tech, market, managers and labels—told from Byrne’s own grind from obscurity to the front. Broad and clear for fans, not deep theory.
summary.zh: 了解摇滚历程之后，再看制作怎么走。作者凭亲身经历写灵感、编写、演出、录制、技术、市场，乃至经纪人与厂牌，也写自己乐队如何从默默无闻学创作走到台前。深入浅出、面面俱到，但不是深理论，更像面向爱好者的科普。

summary.en: Still no compact Chinese Rock Chronicles for domestic acts. This is closer, but remains a cultural study of mainland rock and intellectual currents—not a work catalog. Worth it for reform-era economic and cultural shock on Chinese music and youth, and a partial map of Chinese rock.
summary.zh: 其实想找一本像《摇滚编年史》那样针对国内的简明资料集，可惜市面上还缺。这本相对接近，但仍是文化研究专著：主线是国内摇滚与文化思潮的关系，不是作品梳理。仍很值得推荐——可以看到改革开放后巨大的经济与文化冲击如何落到中国音乐与年轻人身上，从而窥见中国摇滚的部分面貌。

summary.en: A photo book. Sparse text; the camera records Chinese rock on and off stage across that decade—players’ youth, and a slice of our own.
summary.zh: 摄影集。文字不多，摄影师用镜头真实记录这十年中国摇滚台前幕后——能看到乐手们的青春，也能看到我们自己的青春。

summary.en: Early Chinese rock interview book—Cui Jian, Tang Dynasty, Black Panther, Compass, and peers. Honest and serious; does not dodge the historical backdrop. The most grounded group portrait of that first wave.
summary.zh: 早年初版的中国摇滚采访录，崔健、唐朝、黑豹、指南针……非常诚实严肃，面对历史背景也不刻意回避。中国早期摇滚群像最真实的记录，对后来人仍有启发。
